shill: Make DefaultServiceObserver and pass logical and physical Service When Manager finishes sorting its Services, it notifies clients (any instance that has called AddDefaultServiceObserver) of the primary physical Service, if it has changed. In order to implement the concept of a "lower Device" for VirtualDevices, clients must also be able to receive notifications when the logical Service (i.e. the "default Service") has changed. For example, if a VPNService goes down but none of the physical Services change, the physical_service will be unchanged, but the logical_service will change from whatever VPNService was active to the physical_service. Virtual interfaces (e.g. a Crostini tun interface using the default Service) will care about the change of either physical or logical Service. The OpenVPN and Chrome VPNDrivers are modified to behave as before, despite the potential for a notification where the physical_service has not changed. BUG=chromium:999589 TEST=-All unit tests are passing. -Manually tested connected to a VPN, changing back and forth between underlying physical networks, and then disconnecting the VPN. Change-Id: Ia554cb8f771406b981c06884aafa9459ca957098 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1803754 Tested-by: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Eric Caruso <ejcaruso@chromium.org>

FROMLIST: firmware: google: increment VPD key_len properly Commit 4b708b7b1a2c ("firmware: google: check if size is valid when decoding VPD data") adds length checks, but the new vpd_decode_entry() function botched the logic -- it adds the key length twice, instead of adding the key and value lengths separately. On my local system, this means vpd.c's vpd_section_create_attribs() hits an error case after the first attribute it parses, since it's no longer looking at the correct offset. With this patch, I'm back to seeing all the correct attributes in /sys/firmware/vpd/...
